questions.question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

A speech made without preparation
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e. **'Extempore'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** correct word **that can substitute the given group of words* 'A speech made without preparation' *is** 'Extempore'.**
 
• **Extempore refers **to a speech or performance that is given without any prior preparation or memorization.
 
• **It comes from** the Latin phrase 'ex tempore', which means 'out of the moment'.
 
• It is **often used** in public speaking events and debates where participants are expected to speak without any prepared material.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is:** 'Extempore'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's an explanation of the other words:
 
 
• **Parable** (प्रतीकात्मक कहानी) is a simple, typically brief, narrative story, presented to teach a moral lesson or a spiritual truth. These are often used in religious or philosophical texts.
 
• **Eulogy **(स्तुति) is a speech or piece of writing that praises someone or something highly, typically someone who has just died. It is meant to honor and celebrate the life of the person.
 
• **Chronicle **(इतिहास) refers to a factual written account of important or historical events in the order of their occurrence. It's like a record or history.

__
 
• The correct option to fill in the blank is **"parts".**

questions.question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

Lee said to his wife, "I am very happy today."

options.text: Lee told his wife that he was very happy today.
Lee told his wife that he has been very happy that day.
Lee told his wife he was very happy today.
Lee told his wife that he was very happy that day.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Lee told his wife that he was very happy that day.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct indirect form** of the given sentence is option 4: *"Lee told his wife that he was very happy that day."*
 
• **In reported speech,** we typically backshift tenses and adjust time references accordingly.
 
• *"I am very happy today"* in** direct speech becomes** *"he was very happy that day"* in indirect speech.
 
• **"Am" **(present tense) becomes **"was**" (past tense), and "today"** becomes** "that day" to reflect that the report of the speech is happening at a later time.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* 'Lee told his wife that he was very happy that day'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1** is incorrect because it retains **"today" **which should have been changed to "that day" in reported speech.
 
• **Option 2 **is incorrect because** "has been" **changes the tense to present perfect which does not correctly represent the original tense.
 
• **Option 3** is also incorrect because it retains** "today"** which should have been changed to "that day" in reported speech.

questions.question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The child locked the shutters.

options.text: The shutters were locked by the child.
The shutters are locked by the child.
The shutters would be locked by the child.
The shutters had been locked by the child.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** correct passive form** of the given sentence *"The child locked the shutters." *is **option 1:** *"The shutters were locked by the child."*
 
• **When transforming** a sentence from active to passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence, and the subject of the active sentence becomes the agent of the passive sentence, introduced by the preposition "by".
 
• In the original sentence**, "the shutters"** is the object and **"the child" **is the subject.
 
• In the passive voice,** "the shutters"** becomes the subject and** "the child"** becomes the agent.
 
• The verb form** "were locked" **in the passive sentence corresponds to the past simple tense of the verb **"locked"** in the active sentence.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'The shutters were locked by the child'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 **uses the present tense **"are locked",** which doesn't match the past tense of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 3 **uses the conditional form **"would be locked",** which changes the meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4** uses the past perfect tense **"had been locked"**, which also doesn't match the past simple tense of the original sentence.
